source: fitted upstream against the water electron photon lookup table (photon_lookup_table.h5); that table is NOT in this repo, so these coefficients cannot be regenerated here. Verified on arrival: exp(u0-du)=1.0 and exp(u0+du)=100000 match fit_min/max_mev. Unlike the muon, the legacy power law was already accurate across the 400-1800 MeV paper band (-0.01% at 400/600/1000/1400/1800 MeV, 0.065% rms over 100-2000 MeV), so this changes no paper number; it is here because that same power law is wrong by +180.65% at 1 MeV, +56.75% at 2 MeV and +13.38% at 5 MeV -- 10.5% rms over the full 1 MeV-100 GeV table against 0.067% for the polynomial.
